summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The First Trust NASDAQ ABA Community Bank Index Fund (QABA) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the NASDAQ OMX ABA Community Bank index. The fund tracks an index of NASDAQ-listed banks and thrifts, excluding the 50 largest. QABA was launched on Jun 29, 2009 and is issued by First Trust.

holdings.infoBox: QABA is an equity ETF with a total of 162 individual holdings. The top holdings are Wintrust Financial stock at 4.01%, Commerce Bancshares at 3.29%, Central Bancompany at 3.12%, United Bankshares at 2.60%, and Hancock Whitney at 2.41%.
